sections.heading: Pull request — exfer-stack/exfer-py #2 (merged)
sections.text:
feat: generate_address returns the pubkey; list_addresses returns records
In exfer-stack/exfer-py, his own repository.
This pull request is merged.
https://github.com/exfer-stack/exfer-py/pull/2

An agent issuing an EXFER-QUOTE needs the payee pubkey, but `generate_address` dropped it (walletd returns `{address,index,pubkey}`; the client kept only the address) — forcing a `sign_message` workaround. Fix the SDK surface:

- `generate_address() -> GenerateAddressResult {address, pubkey, index}` (was `str`)
- `list_addresses() -> list[AddressRecord] {address, index?, label?, imported?}` (was `list[str]`)
- sync + async, typed in `types.py` + `__all__`; mocked tests assert the new shapes; README/docs/CHANGELOG updated.

Gates green: **pytest 157 passed**, ruff check/format, mypy.
